description: This file contains Python source code implementing functionality for saving and restoring dtensor-based models and variables in TensorFlow's DTensor framework. It includes functions for sharded save operations, enabling bfloat16 checkpointing, and name-based save/restore of DTensors, specifically targeting distributed training scenarios with multiple meshes.

methods.description: Saves given named tensor slices in a sharded, multi-client safe manner, ensuring correct checkpoint directory state with barriers for synchronization.

methods.name: enable_save_as_bf16(variables: List[tf_variables.Variable])
methods.description: Enables checkpointing and restoring of float32 DTensor Variables as bfloat16 for efficiency.

methods.name: name_based_restore( mesh: layout_lib.Mesh, checkpoint_prefix: str, name_tensor_dict: Dict[ str, Union[tensor_lib.Tensor, tf_variables.Variable]], )
methods.description: Restores DTensors from a checkpoint using tensor names, ensuring tensors are placed on CPU before restoring.

methods.name: name_based_save( mesh: layout_lib.Mesh, checkpoint_prefix: Union[str, tensor_lib.Tensor], name_tensor_dict: Dict[ str, Union[tensor_lib.Tensor, tf_variables.Variable]], )
methods.description: Saves DTensors by tensor name into a checkpoint, facilitating distributed save in a single mesh environment.
